title: Summing a set-integral bound over a countable disjoint family of measurable sets
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (g : Euclid P → ℝ) (θ : ℝ) (t : Set (Euclid P)) (B : Euclid P → Set (Euclid P)), t.Countable → (∀ x ∈ t, MeasurableSet (B x)) → t.PairwiseDisjoint B → μ (⋃ x ∈ t, B x) < ∞ → IntegrableOn g (⋃ x ∈ t, B x) μ → (∀ x ∈ t, ∫ y in B x, g y ∂μ ≤ θ * (μ (B x)).toReal) → ∫ y in ⋃ x ∈ t, B x, g y ∂μ ≤ θ * (μ (⋃ x ∈ t, B x)).toReal
